message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the fact: It says: "利用职务之便，伙同...将国家扶贫专项资金6万某予以私分，和某某分得3万某。" This is embezzlement of public funds, i.e., "挪用公款罪" (misappropriation of public funds) or "贪污罪". In Chinese criminal law, using position to divert state funds is "贪污罪" (embezzlement of public money). Also could be "受贿罪"? No, they are not receiving bribes, they are misappropriating funds. So the appropriate charge: 贪污罪. Possibly also "职务侵占罪"? That's for state employees misappropriating public property. In Chinese law, "职务侵占罪" is for public officials who appropriate public property for personal use. However, the typical charge for misappropriating public funds is "贪污罪". The fact says "将国家扶贫专项资金...私分". That's classic "贪污罪". So answer: [罪名]贪污罪<eoa>.

Check if multiple: only one. So format: [罪名]贪污罪<eoa>.
